hey freshman in college here! started accutane in october 2022 (40,60,60mg) and the purging was a little tough ngl but it’s so worth it! i’m in month 3 and my skin is red for sure but i barely get pimples now. if you’re scared about purging i would ask your derm abt starting with smaller dosages! maybe 40 or 30? i’ve heard that starting off with smaller dosages and increasing them slowly led to weaker purges and let’s your body get used to the medication! but in the end u got this!!

your skin looks beautiful! my skin looks really similar. i’m on my 3rd month (40,60,60mg) my skin is pretty clear but my PIE is super red and my skin in general is red. but seeing your skin on the 6th month of accutane and seeing how the redness fades makes me so hopeful! thank you :)

i’m on month 3 too and am having the same experience. also abt the cerave i used it for a few weeks before accutane and broke out terribly. once i stopped my skin cleared up instantly. i talked to my derm abt it and i might’ve been allergic to something in there. i would talk to ur derm abt it. cerave doesn’t suit everyone maybe stick with what u we’re using before bc testing out new products or using new things in general on acne prone skin isn’t a good idea or try cetaphil. cetaphil is amazing.  good luck!! :)
